reviews.comment: He was an terrible professor in the fact that he does not respond to your emails and on top of that you can study all the material for weeks in advance and still not ace your exams due to the fact that he grades so harshly, even when your answer may be very well near to perfect and could be straight from his lectures.

Jewell is an amazing professor who is informed in his subject area. This class is tough and you have to study what he says so you can succeed. Those who complain about the class come in with a negative mindset. Jewell accepts all opinions without bias and those who do bad do not put in the work.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Jewell is clearly very knowledgeable. However the class is very left-leaning. You are expected to rent 2 textbooks and read a total of 25-50 pages per class day, and there are short-answer quizzes over said reading at the end of every week. Don't skip class since his exams (which are short-answer/essays) cover both lectures and readings.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Jewell is very knowledgeable in this subject. He is very lecture heavy, and has you interact by having you participate in class during the lecture that focuses on reasoning, which really helps you understand the concept. He has a quiz every week, and has two exams. Therefore, studying and comprehension is a huge part of passing this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I'm a junior & I've never Q-dropped a class until this one. The topic of the class is political but he only offers one side. His tests are extremely specific & your grade is based on your knowledge of 7-10 concepts out of 100-200. He only had 1 exam graded by Q-drop deadline & his TA does all the grading and she grades hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! HIS TESTS ARE NOT MULTIPLE CHOICE SO GOODLUCK MEMORIZING OVER 200+ TERMS. I FEEL LIKE EVERYONE IS SET UP FOR FAILURE IF YOU TAKE HIS CLASS. IM A JUNIOR AND IVE NEVER TAKEN A CLASS THAT WAS SO DIFFICULT. WHAT HE EXPECTS FROM HIS STUDENTS IS NOT REALISTIC. MAYBE IF YOU WERE ONLY TAKING HIS CLASS AND NOTHING ELSE ITS POSSIBLE
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Jewell is very educated about the subject he teaches. He may look intimidating but he's actually funny here and there. He also asks if there are any questions about the material, he cares and wants you to understand, so ask questions (otherwise he will call on someone random to answer a question).
Amazing lectures, going to class is not required but they're useful for the tests and quizzes. His TA is not very great but it's really up to you to pass.
